text:
alex_g: Heads up — got a billing alert: large GPU on-demand spike in eu-west1. Console shows ~120 new instances in the last 12h and we're getting charged on-demand for many that should be covered by commitments. Investigating autoscaler behavior. :warning:

mira_p: How many of those are actually GPU-capable instances vs CPU-only? Any obvious instance-type mismatch?

alex_g: Quick numbers: ~120 launches, ~85 of them are n1-standard-16 (no GPU) but they're in the 'gpu-pool' autoscaler group. Our reserved commitment is for A2 family (a2-highgpu-1/2/4) in eu-west1 — looks like the commitment isn't being consumed because wrong instance family got launched.
derrick: Autoscaler logs show it fell back to a template named `fallback-template-v2` because it couldn't find the instance template tagged with `gpu=true`. FYI: yesterday's infra PR renamed the label to `gpu_enabled` to be clearer. Autoscaler config still matches on `gpu=true`, so it skipped the intended GPU template.

alex_g: Ok that explains it — autoscaler matched a different template that has no GPUs, and cloud used on-demand n1s. That combination (wrong template + commitment tied to A2) triggered the billing surge.

juan_m: I pulled the autoscaler decision trace: https://console.cloud/decision/trace/xxxx (short link). Key snippet: `chosen_template: fallback-template-v2 reason: label_mismatch(gpu=true)`.

mira_p: Mitigations we should run now: 1) update autoscaler to accept new label key OR revert the label rename, 2) mark non-GPU instances for fast scale-down/drain, 3) open billing dispute with cloud for mismatch window. Also add CI check so label renames fail the infra tests.

derrick: Pushing a quick patch to the autoscaler to accept both keys (`gpu=true` OR `gpu_enabled=true`) — deployed as hotfix (deploy id: hotfix-2026-05-04-03). Also queued a template revert PR.

sre-bot: Action taken: autoscaler config rolled to accept alternate keys. Started draining detected non-GPU nodes in pool `gpu-pool-eu-west1`. Drain plan: max 10 nodes at a time to avoid throttling inference traffic.

alex_g: Good. Finance: can you run a delta on committed usage vs billed over the affected window and raise a support case? We need to try to recoup charges and update commitment planning.

emily_fin: On it. Current estimate: ~$48,200 extra on-demand charges in the last 24h tied to those n1 launches. Opening cloud support ticket now. Ticket #CS-78923 created with billing team and attached logs. Also adding a new alert on 'instance.family != commitment.family' anomaly.

juan_m: One more note — some jobs already landed on the wrong instances. We're launching a small number of A2 replacements and migrating low-priority batches first. Command used to create replacements: `gcloud compute instances create --zone=eu-west1-b --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1 --labels=gpu=true --boot-disk-size=200GB` (dry-run first).

mira_p: For longer term: we should align commitment purchases to an abstract "GPU capacity unit" rather than family-specific when possible, or document conversion/rollback steps when renaming infra labels. Also add webhook to block instance-template pushes that change pool-match labels silently.

derrick: Agree. I'll add an infra CI test: reject PRs that rename `gpu`-related labels unless a follow-up autoscaler config change is present. Also adding post-deploy smoke that validates pool membership.

emily_fin: Cloud support acknowledged, put the case in "investigating" and requested matching audit logs and autoscaler decisions. I've also bumped the billing anomaly threshold temporarily and created a daily report to track reclaimed commitment utilization.

sre-bot: Scaling action summary: 70 non-GPU nodes drained and marked for delete, 25 A2 replacements spun up so far, ongoing migration. No immediate SLA impact reported.

alex_g: Thanks everyone. Action list: derrick -> merge label-tolerance hotfix + CI test (ETA 2h). mira_p -> create admission webhook proposal (ETA EOD). emily_fin -> follow up with cloud support for refund & daily cost report. juan_m -> finish migration plan (ETA 6h). Finance/ops sync at 15:30 UTC.

emily_fin: Accepted. Will keep thread updated with support ticket progress and cost numbers. :thumbsup:

alex_g: Closing the loop later today, please ping if anything unexpected pops up.

mira_p: noted. :white_check_mark:
